title: Demo Studio upstream source catalogue (workers/oep-services.json)
description: Which Open Edge Platform microservices Demo Studio takes from open-edge-platform/edge-ai-libraries ("services": one shared release tag, one sparse clone cached at workers/thirdparty/edge-ai-libraries) and which plain git repositories a worker vendors at a pinned commit or tag ("sources": their own repository and ref, one sparse clone each under workers/thirdparty/git/<name>). Read by workers/oep-setup.sh, workers/oep-setup.ps1 and the Python adapters. Every entry is copied out of its cache into a flat directory next to its worker, patched and overlaid if the entry says so. A worker that is in neither list is custom code.

tag.description: Release tag of edge-ai-libraries every service is fetched at, e.g. 2026.2.1. EDGE_AI_LIBRARIES_REF overrides it for one run; `oep-setup.sh pin <tag>` rewrites it.

services.description: One entry per worker that wraps an upstream microservice and runs it natively (no container).

worker.description: Directory under workers/ that wraps the service, e.g. services/speech-to-text/oep or services/text-to-speech/oep-tts. Its start.sh/setup.sh run `oep-setup.sh fetch <worker>`; optional replacement files live in <worker>/overlay/ (or <worker>/overlay/<name>/ when the worker has several entries).

subdir.description: Path of the microservice inside edge-ai-libraries, e.g. microservices/audio-analyzer. Only this directory is copied to the worker.

name.description: Display name, also the default directory name of the copy. Default: last segment of subdir.

sentinel.description: File relative to subdir that proves the copy is complete, e.g. pipeline.py. Default: the directory itself.

dir.description: Where the microservice is copied to, relative to the worker directory. Default: thirdparty/<name> (add /thirdparty to the worker's .gitignore). The copy carries a .demo-studio-edge-ai-libraries-ref file with the tag it was made from.

home_env.description: Environment variable that, when set, names a directory already holding the microservice (e.g. microservices/<name> of a local edge-ai-libraries checkout) to use instead of the copy. It is used as is: nothing is fetched into or removed from it; overlay/ is still applied.

tag.description: Per-service tag override. Default: the top-level tag.

install.description: How upstream installs the service's Python dependencies (its Dockerfile), for a worker whose .venv is built from upstream's own files rather than a pyproject/uv.lock of ours (workers/scripts/oep_env.py). Paths are relative to the fetched copy, so a tag bump needs no change here unless upstream renames them. <worker>/overrides.txt, when present, is passed as uv overrides: only for what would not install or run on our platforms.

requirements.description: The file upstream installs from: a requirements.txt, or a Poetry pyproject.toml (its [[tool.poetry.source]] URLs become extra indexes).

constraints.description: Upstream's lock, applied as constraints: a poetry.lock (its git packages are held at the locked commit) or a pip constraints file.

uninstall.description: Packages upstream's Dockerfile uninstalls after installing.

python.description: Python version of the environment. Default: 3.12.

sources.description: One entry per upstream git repository a worker vendors; a worker may have several (malaya needs malaya and malaya-speech). `oep-setup.sh fetch <worker>` fetches all of them.

worker.description: Directory under workers/ that uses the code, e.g. services/text-to-speech/kokoro. Its start.sh/start.ps1 fetch the selected worker's sources before syncing its dependencies, so path sources exist when uv uses them.

repository.description: Git URL of the upstream repository, e.g. https://github.com/hexgrad/kokoro.git.

ref.description: The commit (40 hex characters) or tag to vendor. Changed only here: EDGE_AI_LIBRARIES_REF does not apply to sources.

subdir.description: Path inside the repository to copy, usually the Python package directory, e.g. kokoro or malaya_speech. Only this directory is materialised in the sparse clone.

name.description: Display name, the cache directory under workers/thirdparty/git/ and the default directory name of the copy. Default: last segment of subdir.

sentinel.description: File relative to the copy that proves it is complete, e.g. __init__.py (or optimum/exporters/openvino/model_configs.py with keep_root). Default: the directory itself.

dir.description: Where the copy lands, relative to the worker directory. Default: thirdparty/<name> (add it to the worker's .gitignore). The copy carries a .demo-studio-source-ref file with the ref it was made from.

keep_root.description: Copy the repository's top-level files (setup.py, requirements.txt, README) too and keep subdir at its path, so the copy is a buildable project a pyproject.toml can take by path (optimum-intel). Default: false, the subdir's contents are copied flat (an importable package directory, as kokoro is used).

patch.description: A diff kept in the worker directory to apply to the copy after it is made (git apply, outside any repository), e.g. kokoro.patch.

patch_strip.description: Leading path components to strip when applying the patch (git apply -p<n>). A patch made against the repository root for a copy of subdir needs 1 + the depth of subdir; kokoro's is 2. Default: 1.

home_env.description: Environment variable that, when set, names a directory already holding the code (a local checkout) to use instead of the copy. Used as is; overlay/ is still applied.
